n-flying-tesla-roadster.title: Flying Tesla Roadster coins
n-flying-tesla-roadster.summary: Coins named for the Tesla Roadster unveiling. Posts dated 2026-10-16 describe Tesla showing a next-generation Roadster with SpaceX cold-gas thrusters at SpaceX's Texas test site on the evening of 2026-10-15: it drove up a ramp, flipped in the air and landed, with a claimed 0-60 mph in 0.81 seconds and deliveries in 2028 (@niccruzpatane, @cb_doge, e3:1); DEXTools quotes Tesla's "Real life, baby" caption and Elon Musk's reply "Turns out the future does have flying cars" (e3:0). Six coins carry the name: three Flying Tesla Roadster (FTR) contracts on Solana (one on pump.fun, two on Meteora DBC), two 特斯拉能飞 ("flying tesla roadster") coins on Robinhood Chain (Clanker) and BNB Chain (Flap), and Starman (STARMAN, "the driver of the flying Tesla Roadster"). The main pump.fun FTR says it pairs with $SPCX and $TSLA through OTC desks; its pool was created on 2026-10-15 at 02:08 UTC, about a day before the unveiling and after the reveal had been announced, while the other five pools are from the hours after it. An older FTR on StonkFun, created in August, predates the story and is not included, and two further pump.fun FTR contracts are quarantined for extreme 24h moves. These are traders' and the coins' own claims: no coin is shown to be affiliated with Tesla, SpaceX or Elon Musk, most are hours old, and the story is a single event. Measured: six coins across all their pools.

summaries.n-credits-for-holders: Coins that describe turning trading fees into AI model credits for holders. Orbio (orbio.so) says it sells LLM credits at a discount, that the discount comes from Orbio holders who offer unused credit, and that requests are relayed through its managed OpenRouter account; its coin ORBIO (pons, Robinhood Chain) says half of trading fees are converted into inference credits paid to holders. API (pump.fun) says fees are split by holdings and holders can claim SOL or 1.5x credits for GPT, Claude, Grok and Gemini through one OpenAI-compatible API;; bInference (BINF, Flap, BNB Chain) says an agent token's fees pay for the agent's AI and that credits bought with BNB are up to 8% cheaper with $BINF. Public posts from 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10 compare BINF and API with ORBIO, and a rival project, DecentraMind, says ORBIO pioneered the model it builds on. The ORBIO and BINF pools date from 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-30; the API pool was created on 2026-10-09. These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, discounts and usage are not verified, no affiliation among the coins was checked. Measured: four coins across all their pools.

n-flying-tesla-roadster.notice: Posts from 2026-10-16 (e3:1) describe Tesla's live unveiling of a next-generation Roadster with SpaceX cold-gas thrusters on the evening of 2026-10-15, with a claimed 0-60 mph in 0.81 seconds and deliveries targeted for 2028; DEXTools (e3:0) quotes Tesla's "Real life, baby" video caption and Elon Musk's "Turns out the future does have flying cars", and @PumpfunEco, @StalkHQ and @moonshot posted about $FTR on 2026-10-16 (e2:0). @AlJR86 had written on 2026-10-14 that the Roadster would be revealed "TOMORROW" (e3:1).
n-flying-tesla-roadster.interpretation: The event is real and dated, and several chains and launchpads carry coins with its name, so it is treated as a shared story, but it is one news event: demand for the copies can fade within days, the pump.fun FTR launched before the unveiling, and the other five pools are hours old. None of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Tesla, SpaceX or Elon Musk, and the 24h figures are driven by days-old pools with large moves.

n-credits-for-holders.notice: orbio.so (scraped again 2026-10-16, e1:1) is the project's page for LLM credits at a discount ("One key, every model, no subscriptions"). @orbiodotso posted on 2026-10-13 that CREDIT is live on Ethereum mainnet at the same contract address as on Robinhood Chain, with a CREDIT/USDC Uniswap v4 pool and a LayerZero bridge to Robinhood (e1:7). LLMPad (LLM) left on 2026-10-16 after its 24h volume stayed under $1,000.
n-credits-for-holders.interpretation: Several projects pitch the same mechanism, fees or holdings turned into AI credits for holders. Every number is the projects' own claim; payouts, discounts and usage are not verified, API's pool is days old and carries its own risks, RAETO's credits come from tokenized stocks it says it holds, and no affiliation among the coins was checked.

n-super-intelligence.notice: The White House SIF and SpaceXSI posts still date from 2026-10-04 (e1:6). One trader account, @BFGDAO (2026-10-15), says the new task force is reported to hold its first meeting on Thursday; it names no source and nothing official was found. The newest $SI posts (2026-10-15, e1:2) come from coin accounts and traders, one of them a promotion for the $SI coin itself, and a 2026-10-16 trader post says $SI went to $70M.
n-super-intelligence.interpretation: The rename story is real but twelve days old, and volume across the coins is down again (about $3.3M of 24h token volume at discovery against $7.7M in the 2026-10-15 sample). None of the coins is shown to be affiliated with the announcements.

n-creator-fee-routing.notice: usepaid.app (scraped again 2026-10-16, e1:0) still says "UsePaid routes each coin's creator fees to the X account it's launched for. The fees are held for that X user to claim." @TeleMoneySOL's 2026-10-12 recap still reports 108 coins launched, 262.8 SOL in creator fees generated and 17,411.2 GRAM paid out, and on 2026-10-13 it announced an update under which holders of 0.1% of $TM or more could get 25% of the fees back for newly deployed tokens. @UsePaid posted on 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-11 that @TAsimovF claimed $1,562.44, $2,375.79 and $6,936.66 in creator fees through UsePaid (e1:8). CLAIM, a pump.fun launchpad where a named creator has 14 days to claim fees before 80% goes to holders, is described in 2026-10-14 posts (e2:8) but is under the market cap bar and not added. On 2026-10-15 @usemakepad introduced Make, a Solana launchpad that launches a coin for anyone on X through pump.fun and sends them earnings from its creator fees (e1:8).
n-creator-fee-routing.interpretation: Several launch tools pitch the same mechanism, creator fees paid to a named account or person, and the sources are the same as on 2026-10-13: the tools' own pages and posts plus their users. The figures are the projects' own and payouts are not verified. The coins are not shown to be affiliated with the people named, or with each other; MarsX is the youngest of the six (pool created 2026-10-12), and volume across the six fell 28.8% against the prior 24 hours.

k-flying.reason: Created n-flying-tesla-roadster. Six coins named for the Tesla Roadster unveiling on four covered launchpads (pump.fun, Meteora DBC, Clanker, Flap) and three chains: FTR on pump.fun ($24.5M), 特斯拉能飞 on Clanker ($10.4M), FTR on Meteora DBC ($5.1M and $1.8M), 特斯拉能飞 on Flap ($4.0M) and STARMAN ($1.4M), $47.3M combined 24h volume against the $500K bar, each with a market cap above $100K and no quarantine flag. The independent source is the event itself: posts dated 2026-10-16 from @niccruzpatane, @cb_doge and @latestinspace describe Tesla's live unveiling (e3:1), and DEXTools quotes Tesla's and Musk's posts (e3:0). Not added: the StonkFun FTR (pool created 2026-08-15, predates the story), RDSTR (market cap $47.6K, under the $100K bar) and two pump.fun FTR contracts (extreme 24h move, quarantined). This reverses the 2026-10-15 deferral (k-sym-FTR: three copies of one meme and a one-day hook): the rule as written is met, the coins now span three chains and four launchpads at $47.3M, and the owner should say whether copies of one meme should count; flagged. A cap replacement: Tokenized stocks and RWA coins leaves (see retiredNarratives).

k-through.reason: The word "through" over FTR (placed in Flying Tesla Roadster coins), BURROW (a dark web launchpad on Robinhood Chain) and BOOT (a GitHub agent launchpad): no shared story beyond the one FTR is already assigned to.

k-stocks.reason: STONK ("Backed by stocks", StonkFun's own coin, $6.5M), BUBBLE ("The Official coin for all ai stocks", $3.2M, 14 hours old) and OTC ("earn stocks, pre-ipo, and yield", $1.9M) share the word stocks. STONK and OTC are the Solana stock-meme pair (a 2026-09-07 @cfm_sol post compares both as "tokenized stocks + Meme"; @otc_labs posted its own revenue on 2026-10-15, e2:3), but BUBBLE is an AI-stock meme with no such mechanism, so only two coins share a mechanism. Not created; no cap room for a second new narrative, since the cap replacement went to Flying Tesla Roadster. Re-evaluate; flagged for the owner.

k-created.reason: The word "created" over GOAT (the 2024 truth_terminal meme), BOOT and MVP (a crypto analytics terminal): three unrelated coins; the story search (e2:2) returned GOAT11 call-group posts and prop-firm ads.

k-earn.reason: The word "earn" over OTC (earn stocks), GP (RuneScape Gold), HRX (trading agents that earn), VCAT (hold VCAT, earn VVV) and HEDGE (a stock treasury that lends and writes covered calls): different products with no shared mechanism.

k-robinhood.reason: BURROW (a dark web launchpad), IRIDIUS (swaps for Robinhood Stock Tokens) and SECTORAL (encrypted on-chain banking) share the word Robinhood only; the stock-token coins that belong together (IRIDIUS, HEDGE) sat with Tokenized stocks, which left at the cap today, and none is a new story.
